description.value:
Speed +10 feet. At combat start or after a support Ultimate, party critical threshold −1 and critical damage bonus +2, plus your Energy Regeneration score +2, for 3 turns. Start combat with 3 Energy for each ally.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching elation Path required.
